message:
New incoming external reports: sub-exponential 3SAT / ETH packets

Commit, unchanged and as delivered, the five sub-exponential 3SAT (ETH)
arrivals that the drop process had staged but not committed, so that each
stays recoverable after the placement commit retires it (docs/incoming
README, section 1):

- cauchy_mode_improvement_2026-10-26.zip (603,205 bytes): factorial
  Cauchy modes for the contraction of the OpenAI ETH preprint.
- eth_contraction_improvements.zip (462,089 bytes): tapered Hermite
  count, revised contraction schedule, streamed packet extraction.
- sat_density_improvement.zip (476,245 bytes): clause-density-aware
  exact k-SAT counting.
- paper.pdf (887,884 bytes): OpenAI, "The Exponential Time Hypothesis is
  False" (25 October 2026), byte-identical to paper.pdf in
  openai/math@7ef5c0cc5ca4b0e072b7a050fca09ab24bc6fa3a.
- eth.pdf (868,673 bytes): "A 2^{o(n)} time algorithm for 3-SAT"
  (26 October 2026), a separate 49-page manuscript.

Path-limited: no other staged or modified path is included.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
